document.title: A merged pull request's review and evidence stay up for 30 days
document.summary: The `Pages reviews` workflow no longer deletes a review when its pull request closes.
document.why: [PR #154](source:s1) says a merged PR's hosted review and screenshots died within a minute of closing, breaking links in its description and the agent's last message.

sources.label: PR #154
sources.title: ci(pages): a merged pull request's review and evidence stay up for 30 days

groups.title: Keep reviews after close
groups.summary: The workflow drops its `pull_request: closed` trigger and `prune --pr` step, and the skill and sites index say 30 days instead of on close.

attention.note: Closing a pull request, merged or not, no longer starts the workflow, so `pr/<n>/` on `gh-pages` stays public until the daily `prune --ttl-days 30` sees a `publishedAt` 30 days old. An abandoned PR's review and evidence screenshots now stay up as long as a merged one's. `prune --pr <n>` by hand is the only faster removal.

notes.body: `publishPagesReview` sets `publishedAt` to now on every publish, so a republish restarts the 30 days.

fileNotes..github/workflows/pages-reviews.yml: Runs only on the cron and `workflow_dispatch`; the TTL step loses its `if`.
fileNotes..agents/skills/pages/scripts/pages-revie: `pagesIndexHtml` drops the on-close sentence; the live index changes at the next publish or prune.
fileNotes..agents/skills/pages/SKILL.md: The Remove section says the workflow runs only the daily TTL prune.
